**Not ready to publish.** One claim needs to change.

**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Tea Subscription UK" | Fine. It describes the product and market. |
| "Monthly loose leaf tea." | Fine. Product fact. |
| "If your box isn't right, we'll make it right." | **Unsupported.** This is a satisfaction guarantee, implying a remedy such as a replacement or refund. The brand policy has no such promise. It only says subscribers can pause or cancel any time. |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25." | Allowlisted. The landing page must state the same £25 threshold. |

**Other notes**
- No character limit was given. The description is about 105 characters, which exceeds the common 90-character limit for search ad descriptions. Check it against your platform's limit.
- No fake urgency, health claims, superlatives or invented stats.

**Compliant version (87 characters in the description)**
- Headline: Tea Subscription UK
- Description: Monthly loose leaf tea, packed by hand in Bristol. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

If you want to promise a remedy for unsatisfactory boxes, send the actual policy (refund, replacement, time window). Then the line can go back in as `[PROOF NEEDED: returns/satisfaction policy]` until it's confirmed. "Pause or cancel any time" is a safe alternative if it fits the character limit.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "If your box isn't right, we'll make it right.", "type": "guarantee"}], "publish": false}
```
